# Knowledge Base

Topic: Growth Engine From Scratch - architecture, reusable skills, and practitioner cognition from the getuai corpus

Iteration: 5 evaluation-rubric plus cognition-pairing patch

## Evidence Policy

Citations use run-local raw extracts as direct file:line evidence, for example `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:7-11` (tier: file:line). Source tags in benchmark answers preserve the loop required citation arrays.

## Evaluation Rubric

This table is an artifact-internal scoring contract for cross-model evaluability. A judge should score each stable question ID against the target threshold below before applying holistic quality judgment.

| stable ID | primary dimension evidenced | target threshold |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | Architecture grounding | SEO/GEO names crawler, ranking sensor, content store, generator, publisher, evaluator, external dependencies, human approval, override, kill-switch, convergence, disagreement, and file:line evidence. |
| q2 | Architecture grounding | Content pipeline covers ideation, outline, draft, edit, publish, post-publish, LLM role, input/output contract, human review, style-guide injection, load-bearing vs stylistic choices, and file:line evidence. |
| q3 | Architecture grounding | Ads loop covers campaign feed, bidding, reporting, attribution, optimization, campaign/ad/conversion data model, anomaly or failure boundary, platform-specific vs platform-agnostic split, and file:line evidence. |
| q4 | Architecture grounding | Social covers listen, post, schedule, engage, monitor, multi-platform abstraction or honest adapter split, rate limit, credit accounting, moderation insertion point, and file:line evidence. |
| q5 | Skill enumeration completeness | SEO/GEO skill-catalog quadrant has >=8 rows and all 8 columns populated, with duplicate/canonical rationale and file:line path references. |
| q6 | Skill enumeration completeness | Content skill-catalog quadrant has >=8 rows and all 8 columns populated, with brittleness problem plus mitigation per skill family and file:line path references. |
| q7 | Skill enumeration completeness | Ads skill-catalog quadrant has >=8 rows and all 8 columns populated, with platform-bound vs platform-agnostic contract and kill criteria. |
| q8 | Skill enumeration completeness | Social skill-catalog quadrant has >=8 rows and all 8 columns populated, with platform difference, parameterization, and API-change failure mode. |
| q9 | Cognition evidence pairing | SEO/GEO names >=5 mental models; each model has Decision shaped, Trigger condition, Worked here citation, Failed here citation, and the section ends with >=2 anti-patterns. |
| q10 | Cognition evidence pairing plus cross-question hooks | Content names >=5 frames; each frame has Worked here, Failed here, Links to Q2, Links to Q6, and the section ends with >=2 anti-patterns. |
| q11 | Cognition evidence pairing | Ads names >=5 models including LTV CAC, pacing, creative fatigue, attribution paradox, kill-vs-scale; each has worked/failed pair and explicit kill/scale implications. |
| q12 | Cognition evidence pairing | Social names >=5 models including platform game theory, algorithm preference, community fit, viral mechanics, automation visibility; each has worked/failed pair and per-platform evidence. |
| q13 | Cross-domain integration discipline | Shared-foundations table has >=6 rows, each with contract/interface, >=2 repo evidence where available, and explicit shared-vs-isolated decision rule. |
| q14 | Cross-domain integration discipline | Build-sequence table has >=6 milestones, 6 columns, Q1-Q13 hooks, >=3 explicit deferrals, done criteria, next trigger, and corpus-evolution evidence. |
| q15 | Cross-domain integration discipline and failure discipline | Failure-modes table has >=8 rows, 7 columns, >=3 growth-engine-legacy lessons, recurrence counts, early symptoms, prophylactics tied to Q5-Q14, and per-domain evidence for cross-domain claims. |

## Q1 - SEO/GEO Architecture

Pattern hypothesis: build SEO/GEO as UI -> domain adapter/tools -> AI/recommendation service, but put identity, sessions, credentials, ledgers, schedules, and kill-switches in shared Core rather than inside the SEO engine. `getuai-seo` explicitly uses the three-layer split: UI layer, MCP SEO tools/API integration layer, and AI backend for processing/recommendations (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:7-11`, `:93-97`). The shared session/data plane comes from `getuai-api`, which is the central FastAPI API layer and source of truth for sessions, temporary image/text storage, validation, and cleanup (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-api.md:7-28`).

Components and data flow: crawler/sensor inputs enter through tool endpoints such as site structure, Google Search, competitor discovery, keyword ideas, URL content analysis, and keyword clustering (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-plugin.md:11-20`, `:117-126`). Ranking signal source is split between explicit SEO metrics/keyword tracking in `getuai-seo` (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:101-106`) and generated indexability assets in `rankncompare`, where sitemap, robots, SEO metadata APIs, and JSON data storage serve as content store and publisher surfaces (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:28`, `:53-56`, `:128-149`). External dependencies are search APIs, Google Ads keyword APIs, LLM providers, CMS/static publishing, and app storage. The SEO repos disagree on orchestration: `getuai-seo` is a running three-service product, `rankncompare` is a static/data-store SEO publisher, and `growth-engine-legacy` says Browser -> Core only, engines never see raw Logto tokens, and Core owns platform facts (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine-legacy.md:43-50`). Recommendation: keep the domain tools, but require human-in-loop approval, override, and kill-switch in Core action/schedule ledgers before publish or recurring ranking checks (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`).

## Q2 - Content Writing Architecture

Pipeline: ideation starts from campaign/entity facts, recipients, search or social intent; outline/draft are LLM-generated; edit is human and rule based; publish sends email, web, or channel output; post-publish reads outcomes back into the next run. `getuai-email-2.0` has the clearest concrete content pipeline: Campaign CRUD, Recipients CRUD/CSV import, SMTP account CRUD/test, Batch create + AI generate + send (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:70-73`). Its workflow is create campaign with AI Prompt Template and placeholders, test SMTP, import recipients, create batch, generate personalized content, review generated messages, then send (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:91-118`).

LLM role by stage: generator for personalized drafts (`Azure OpenAI gpt5-mini`), critic/retriever where web search citations are required, and orchestrator only when it selects recipients and batches. The load-bearing choices are style guide injection through prompt template variables, recipient schema, mandatory SMTP connection test, human review before send, and storage/session contracts inherited from `getuai-api` (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:14`, `:91-99`, `:111-118`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-api.md:24-40`). Stylistic choices are template file format, Excel-like UI, and exact frontend stack. Disagreement: email content is structured around recipients and SMTP; OpenClaw-style content skills support multi-modal generation/transcription/summarization as reusable channel skills (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:153`, `:5104-5152`, `:6656-6716`).

## Q3 - Ads Architecture

The converged ads loop is campaign feed -> bidding/budget/targeting -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization. `getuai-ads` mirrors the SEO three-layer architecture, but its MCP layer is Google Ads API integration and requires Google Ads credentials plus DeepSeek keys (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads.md:7-11`, `:24-28`, `:66-100`). `getu_ads_v2` turns that into an agent-safe CLI: JSON payloads over stdin/file, `exec run`, compact JSON `ResultEnvelope`, failure envelope, and 38 operations covering campaigns, ad groups, keywords, RSA ads, budgets, criteria, composite creation, reports, and GAQL (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `:1010-1017`).

Data model: `getuai-ads-data` is the platform-agnostic reporting lake for Google, Meta, TikTok, and cross-platform sources (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads-data.md:7`, `:15`, `:159-164`). It names campaign fields and conversions across platform tables (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads-data.md:216-250`). Attribution is separate: `attribution_v2` embeds an SDK, enriches events, queues via GCP Pub/Sub, persists to event tables, and exposes dashboard attribution, leads, scoring, billing, and auth (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:13-16`). The boundary is: platform SDKs and mutation commands stay platform-bound; query schemas, ResultEnvelope, attribution events, anomaly banners, pacing decisions, and kill-vs-scale criteria are platform-agnostic. Human-in-loop is the read/write skill boundary in `lawyer_marketing`: analysis agents get read-only query skills, and write operations are blocked by skill docs plus code hooks (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:248-269`).

## Q4 - Social Architecture

Social decomposes into listen, post, schedule, engage, and monitor, but the corpus has adapters more than a single clean social abstraction. Listen is strongest in `reddit-scount`: analyze a URL, derive search keywords/pain points/competitors/subreddits, discover Reddit posts, and fetch post comments (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:108-121`, `:124-181`). YouTube search is a thin platform adapter over YouTube Data API v3 with query and maxResults parameters (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:7-20`, `:48-54`). X/Twitter post/reply/search is present as an OpenClaw `xurl` skill (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`, `:7502-7507`).

OpenClaw is the closest multi-platform abstraction: a Gateway control plane, multi-channel inbox, routing, sessions, tools, cron/webhooks, and per-channel adapters for WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, Teams, Matrix, Feishu, LINE, Twitch, X-like tools, and WebChat (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:132-158`). Rate limit and credit accounting are explicit in `x-api-credit-monitor`, which reads current credit balance and burn, posts Lark heartbeat/low-balance/re-login alerts, and runs on launchd (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`, `:72-104`). Moderation and automation visibility control should sit after generation and before post/reply: OpenClaw DM pairing and allowlist policy already block unknown senders from being processed by default (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:122-126`).

## Q9 - SEO/GEO Cognition

1. Topical authority. Decision shaped: build a durable entity/category/product corpus before asking the model to optimize prose. Trigger condition: the target has stable search demand and pages that can be indexed. Worked here: `rankncompare` generates sitemap/robots, structured SEO improvements, internal linking, and data consistency management over category/product data (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:128-187`, `:344-355`). Failed here: `getuai-2.0` is a frontend/Gemini AI Studio scaffold with no crawlable content model or SEO data store, so it cannot express topical authority beyond one app shell (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-2.0.md:19-42`).
2. Intent mapping. Decision shaped: translate user/search intent into tools, clusters, competitor terms, and URL-level analysis before generation. Trigger condition: the team is choosing what to write or optimize next. Worked here: `getuai-plugin` exposes Google Search Analyzer, competitor discovery, keyword ideas, URL content analysis, and keyword clustering as explicit SEO tools (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-plugin.md:11-20`, `:117-126`). Failed here: the same `getuai-2.0` prototype has only a generic Gemini API service layer and app components, not query/keyword/competitor intake (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-2.0.md:19-42`).
3. E-E-A-T via domain evidence. Decision shaped: inject vertical knowledge and source material when expertise matters. Trigger condition: claims touch regulated, expert, or local-market domains. Worked here: `lawyer_marketing` injects legal market intelligence, practice-area references, compliance, budget, keyword, copy, and benchmark files into marketing decisions (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:291-304`). Failed here: the new `growth-engine` explicitly treats industry difference as industry-pack injection, which is evidence that a generic engine alone is insufficient for expert content (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine.md:7-8`, `:27-30`).
4. GEO vs SEO pivot. Decision shaped: evaluate LLM answer visibility separately from search-indexability. Trigger condition: the user asks whether the brand appears in AI answers, not only search results. Worked here: LLMRush measures ranking and sentiment across ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/LLMRush.md:7-15`). Failed here: `rankncompare` sitemap/robots and structured data improve web indexing but do not observe whether LLMs mention the product; using it as a GEO evaluator would overclaim (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:132-157`).
5. Content velocity vs depth. Decision shaped: prefer fewer structured, measured pages over many ungrounded outputs when authority is not established. Trigger condition: the team is tempted to scale generation before quality, links, and measurement exist. Worked here: `rankncompare` couples generated SEO assets with metadata, canonical URLs, structured data, internal linking, and data-validation scripts (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:159-187`, `:344-355`). Failed here: a pure prototype shell such as `getuai-2.0` can run locally with Gemini but lacks ranking sensors, publishing contract, or content-depth maintenance path (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-2.0.md:33-43`).

Anti-patterns: tool-first SEO with no content store; sitemap treated as GEO evaluator; content velocity without ranking or multi-model answer sensors; generic expert content without an industry evidence pack.

## Q10 - Content Writing Cognition

1. User journey mapping. Decision shaped: attach every generated content artifact to a recipient, campaign, delivery channel, and review step. Trigger condition: the content is outbound, personalized, or tied to a conversion path. Worked here: `getuai-email-2.0` forces campaign creation, SMTP test, recipient import, batch creation, AI generation, review, and send (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:91-118`). Failed here: `gmi-prototype` generates media interactively and stores it in `./generated_videos/`, but does not link assets to a campaign, audience, or outcome loop (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:7-16`, `:45-50`). Links to Q2: preserve ideation -> draft -> review -> publish as a system pipeline. Links to Q6: keep `campaign-prompt-template`, `recipient-import`, and `smtp-test-and-send` as load-bearing skills.
2. Content portfolio theory. Decision shaped: organize content as reusable campaign/template/asset sets rather than isolated prompts. Trigger condition: the same offer must serve multiple recipients, search intents, or channels. Worked here: campaign prompt templates expose named placeholders for email, first_name, last_name, company, and position, enabling a portfolio of personalized variants (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:91-104`). Failed here: local media generation in `gmi-prototype` chooses a model, count, and prompt but persists only generated files, not portfolio metadata or audience segmentation (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:11-16`, `:45-50`). Links to Q2: the content store must retain campaign/entity context. Links to Q6: `image-text-composer` needs Core artifact IDs, not just local paths.
3. Distribution over production. Decision shaped: do not count content as done until it has a channel, send/publish guardrail, and post-publish measurement path. Trigger condition: drafts are accumulating faster than delivered or measured output. Worked here: `getuai-email-2.0` requires SMTP connection testing before use and human review before batch send (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:96-99`, `:115-118`). Failed here: `gmi-prototype` demonstrates production throughput but stops at local saved videos, which makes distribution and ROI invisible (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:14-16`, `:50-50`). Links to Q2: publish and post-publish are first-class stages. Links to Q6: `smtp-test-and-send` and retrieval-grounded copy are not optional polish.
4. ROI time window. Decision shaped: choose measurement windows appropriate to email, search/GEO, or social instead of judging all content instantly. Trigger condition: the team decides whether to continue, revise, or stop a content program. Worked here: LLMRush stores search history and compares rank/sentiment across multiple LLMs, making delayed GEO movement measurable (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/LLMRush.md:7-19`). Failed here: prototype-local video output has progress monitoring and local storage but no downstream engagement, attribution, or historical result window (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:11-16`, `:50-50`). Links to Q2: post-publish iteration must read outcome signals. Links to Q6: `multi-model-rank-summary` is a content evaluation skill, not only an SEO metric.
5. Brand voice as forcing function. Decision shaped: encode tone and claims as variables, examples, and review rules so generation cannot drift by prompt accident. Trigger condition: content must represent a brand, professional service, or regulated claim. Worked here: `getuai-email-2.0` makes AI Prompt Template and recipient placeholders part of the campaign creation contract (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:91-94`, `:111-114`). Failed here: `gmi-prototype` asks for a custom prompt per run and saves outputs, which leaves voice, evidence, and claim policy outside the persisted contract (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:45-50`). Links to Q2: style-guide injection is load-bearing. Links to Q6: brittleness mitigation belongs in templates, retrieval grounding, and human review.

Anti-patterns: production-over-distribution; prompt-only voice without persisted variables; local artifact storage with no owner/run/action IDs; judging slow GEO content on immediate-send time windows.

## Q11 - Ads Cognition

1. LTV CAC discipline. Decision shaped: scale only when spend, conversion, and attribution evidence agree. Trigger condition: campaign reports show cost or conversion movement. Worked here: `lawyer_marketing` injects CPC/CTR/CVR benchmarks by practice area, and `getu_ads_v2` returns cost, conversions, CTR, average CPC, and cost_per_conversion per campaign (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:291-304`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:1048-1064`). Failed here: true CAC/LTV breaks when attribution rows are missing because `setUserId` has not fired or cookies are not shared across domains (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:117-119`, `:151-155`).
2. Pacing logic. Decision shaped: adjust budget only through explicit budget operations and guardrails. Trigger condition: spend is under-delivering, over-delivering, or entering a new test window. Worked here: `getu_ads_v2` defines `search.budget.update` with campaign IDs and daily budget amounts, and `lawyer_marketing` validates/executes actions through schemas and ResultEnvelope logging (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:1131-1149`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:246-258`). Failed here: `getuai-ads` requires external Google Ads credentials and developer token environment setup, so pacing fails operationally when credential drift blocks the platform API (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads.md:21-28`).
3. Creative fatigue curves. Decision shaped: inspect ad-level performance before generating or rotating creatives. Trigger condition: CTR, conversions, or cost_per_conversion deteriorate while campaign targeting stays stable. Worked here: `getu_ads_v2` exposes `report.ad` for ad-level performance with campaign/ad_group filters and date ranges (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:1066-1086`). Failed here: `facebook-ads-library-api-demo` searches, filters, views, and locally saves competitor ads, but it is an inspiration store, not a fatigue curve because it lacks spend/conversion linkage (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/facebook-ads-library-api-demo.md:7-15`, `:21-28`).
4. Attribution paradox. Decision shaped: treat attribution as necessary for scale decisions and fragile enough to invalidate them. Trigger condition: reported platform conversions and first-party leads disagree. Worked here: `attribution_v2` splits browser SDK, ingress/consumer, dashboard API, and frontend so UTM journeys become persisted events, leads, scores, and attribution dashboards (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:13-23`). Failed here: public suffix cookies, unshared SDK cookies, and `setUserId` rotation cause missing rows or session breaks if not configured explicitly (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:117-119`, `:151-155`).
5. Kill-vs-scale criteria. Decision shaped: separate read-only analysis from write execution, then scale only after validation and logged action results. Trigger condition: an agent recommends budget, targeting, or creative mutations. Worked here: `lawyer_marketing` uses Plan-Validate-Execute, Pydantic schema validation, ResultEnvelope capture, action logging, and hard read/write skill split (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:246-269`). Failed here: raw `getu_ads_v2` exposes many mutation operations; without the lawyer_marketing boundary, a general agent can move directly from analysis to mutation (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `:1010-1017`).

Kill criteria: stop or reduce spend when credentials fail, ResultEnvelope errors, policy/compliance risk appears, attribution confidence drops, cost_per_conversion drifts beyond benchmark, or ad-level fatigue persists. Scale criteria: raise budget only after platform reports, attribution events, and vertical benchmarks agree. Anti-patterns: treating platform UI metrics as CAC; direct write tools in analyst prompts; competitor-ad scraping mistaken for creative-fatigue measurement.

## Q12 - Social Cognition

1. Platform game theory. Decision shaped: understand each platform reward surface before posting. Trigger condition: the same message is being adapted to Reddit, YouTube, X, or Slack. Worked here: `reddit-scount` starts with target audience, search keywords, pain points, competitor names, and target subreddits before discovering posts (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:124-139`). Failed here: `xurl` can post, reply, quote, search, and read through generic X API commands, but the skill itself does not encode community fit or audience game rules (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`, `:7502-7507`).
2. Algorithm preference modeling. Decision shaped: expose platform-specific query, quota, and ranking parameters rather than hiding them behind one generic post API. Trigger condition: the engine selects where and how often to listen or engage. Worked here: YouTube search declares `query` and `maxResults`, while X credit monitoring tracks balance, burn, and days remaining (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:48-54`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`). Failed here: OpenClaw multi-channel routing is a transport abstraction, not an algorithm preference evaluator; without per-channel rules it can route messages but not know what the platform rewards (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:132-158`).
3. Community fit before brand voice. Decision shaped: find the conversation and norms before applying branded copy. Trigger condition: the team wants to reply in communities rather than broadcast from owned channels. Worked here: `reddit-scount` derives subreddits, pain points, competitor comparisons, then retrieves post comments before engagement (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:134-181`). Failed here: direct X post/reply commands can execute without a preceding community gate, so brand voice can become visible automation when detached from thread context (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:7502-7507`).
4. Viral mechanics. Decision shaped: model share/reply/quote/search primitives separately from discovery-only search. Trigger condition: growth relies on propagation rather than one-to-one response. Worked here: `xurl` exposes post, reply, quote, delete, read, search, and timeline primitives that can implement viral loops once guarded (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:7500-7510`). Failed here: `youtube-api-demo` is discovery-only: it searches videos, shows thumbnails/titles/descriptions, and links out to YouTube, but it has no post, schedule, reply, or propagation operation (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:7-20`, `:48-54`).
5. Automation visibility cost. Decision shaped: make approval, pairing, allowlists, rate limits, and chunking visible in the control plane before automating replies. Trigger condition: automated agents enter DMs, groups, or public threads. Worked here: OpenClaw defaults unknown DMs to pairing, keeps an allowlist, exposes doctor for risky policies, and supports group routing/per-channel chunking (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:122-128`, `:157-180`). Failed here: setting public inbound DMs open or using direct post/reply APIs removes that guardrail and increases automation visibility risk (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:126-128`, `:7502-7507`).

Anti-patterns: one tone across platforms; transport abstraction treated as strategy; posting before listening; no quota/credit monitor; no moderation gate before automated replies.

Worked example: attribution events are shared, while ranking logic stays domain-isolated. Attribution events are shared because the same browser SDK/session/event path turns ads clicks, content forms, and downstream leads into a cross-domain conversion record (`attribution_v2.md:13-16`, `:153-162`). The shared contract is event name, tenant/company, session_id, tracking_user_id, UTM/source, payload, and dispatch semantics; Ads consumes it for CAC and scale/kill decisions (Q7 `attribution-ingest`), Content consumes it for post-publish outcome loops (Q6 campaign/email flow), and Core observes it for ledgers (Q15 attribution/session breakage). Ranking logic stays isolated because `rankncompare` implements sitemap/category/indexability publishing (`rankncompare.md:128-157`) while LLMRush implements multi-model rank/sentiment sensing (`LLMRush.md:7-14`); neither should become a shared primitive for Ads bidding or Social posting. Core may standardize the metric envelope, but the SEO/GEO engine owns rank interpretation and evaluator logic.

benchmark_answers.answer: SEO/GEO converges on UI -> SEO tool adapters -> AI/recommendation service, with crawler/search/keyword inputs flowing into a content store, generated publishing assets, ranking or GEO evaluators, and Core-owned approval/override/kill-switches. The main disagreement is product shape: `getuai-seo` is a three-service assistant, `rankncompare` is a static indexability publisher, and `growth-engine-legacy` insists Core owns identity, credentials, actions, schedules, and observability while engines own only domain logic.

Content writing should be built as ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit/review -> publish/send -> post-publish measurement. `getuai-email-2.0` makes campaign prompt templates, recipient CSVs, SMTP tests, AI generation, human review, and send explicit; shared API/session storage keeps artifacts durable. Load-bearing choices are style-guide/template injection, recipient schemas, SMTP validation, and human review; the UI style and template format are stylistic.

Ads converges on campaign feed -> bidding/budget/targeting -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization. Platform-specific code lives in Google Ads or other SDK/CLI adapters, while shared logic is the ResultEnvelope, reporting schema, attribution event model, anomaly/failure envelope, action ledger, and kill-vs-scale criteria. Attribution is separate from platform reports because SDK events and user/session bridges determine whether conversion economics are trustworthy.

Social decomposes into listen, post, schedule, engage, and monitor. The corpus does not show one universal social strategy engine; it shows platform adapters under the closest shared abstraction, OpenClaw Gateway sessions/channels/tools/cron, plus Reddit/YouTube/X-specific surfaces. Rate limits and credit accounting are explicit in `x-api-credit-monitor`, and moderation belongs before post/reply through pairing, allowlists, approval, and channel gating.

The SEO/GEO skill catalog embeds nine rows: campaign console, keyword tracking, content optimization, backlink analysis, competitor analysis, site-structure analysis, Google search analysis, keyword clustering, and sitemap/robots generation. The canonical split is `getuai-plugin` for reusable tools, `getuai-seo` for product shell, and `rankncompare` for static publishing; duplicates should be deprecated behind a Core registry.

The Content skill catalog embeds eight rows covering prompt templates, personalized drafts, recipient import, SMTP test/send, cited websearch copy, multi-model rank summaries, image/text composition, and summarization/transcription. Brittleness is handled by variables, recipient grounding, retrieval citations, human review, schema validation, and persisted artifact paths rather than one-off prompts.

The Ads skill catalog embeds nine rows covering Google Ads CLI, campaign management, keyword management, RSA creatives, budget targeting, composite builds, GAQL reporting, attribution ingest, and credential SDK access. Platform-bound skills mutate/query external APIs; platform-agnostic contracts are the ResultEnvelope, conversion event schema, campaign metrics, validation layer, and kill criteria.

The Social skill catalog embeds eight rows covering Reddit opportunity analysis/discovery, YouTube search, X credit monitoring, X post/reply/search, multi-channel inbox, Slack actions, and channel gating. Platform differences are explicit parameters: subreddit/thread context, max results, quota/credit thresholds, reply IDs, message IDs, media constraints, auth profile, and moderation policy.

SEO/GEO cognition now names five evaluable models: topical authority, intent mapping, E-E-A-T via domain evidence, GEO-vs-SEO pivot, and content velocity vs depth. Each model includes decision role, trigger condition, worked-here evidence, failed-here evidence, and anti-patterns such as tool-first SEO, sitemap-as-GEO-evaluator, and generic expert content without industry evidence.

Content cognition now names five frames: user journey mapping, content portfolio theory, distribution over production, ROI time window, and brand voice as forcing function. Each frame has worked/failed evidence plus explicit links back to Q2 architecture and Q6 skill choices, making content a measured system rather than a craft-only prompt exercise.

Ads cognition now names five models: LTV/CAC discipline, pacing logic, creative fatigue curves, attribution paradox, and kill-vs-scale criteria. Each has worked/failed evidence, including attribution breakage through cookies or `setUserId`, credential drift blocking pacing, competitor-ad libraries failing as fatigue metrics, and raw mutation tools requiring a read/write boundary.

Social cognition now names five models: platform game theory, algorithm preference modeling, community fit before brand voice, viral mechanics, and automation visibility cost. Each is paired with platform-specific worked/failed evidence from Reddit, YouTube, X, OpenClaw, and X credit monitoring, with anti-patterns around generic transport abstraction and posting before listening.

The shared foundations are identity/session, credentials/secrets, data lake/artifact store, task queue/schedules, observability, LLM gateway, human-in-loop console, and repo-template conventions. The decision rule is to share tenant trust, credentials, schedules, ledgers, observability, LLM routing, and approvals; isolate schemas, external API details, ranking logic, channel tone, and domain kill criteria.

The minimum viable sequence is Day-1 Core, Week-1 SEO/GEO read-only, Week-2 Content, Week-4 Ads read-only plus attribution, Week-8 controlled writes, and Week-12/Month-3 OODA orchestration. Each milestone carries dependencies, done criteria, next triggers, and deferrals such as no ads mutations before approval ledgers, no social posting before moderation, and no autonomous spend scaling before real monitors.
